purpose: Unified front-left three-quarter vehicle cutouts for owner catalog cards and home hero presentation.

rendering.camera: front-left three-quarter view, near headlight height
rendering.lighting: soft neutral studio light with restrained tire contact shadow

sourcePolicy: Every generated cutout is bound to the exact catalog model id and uses an existing exact-model reference image. Original approved cutouts retain their existing model binding. Generated cutouts are presentation references and do not represent the owner's model year, trim, color or physical vehicle.
promptTemplate: Create a polished exact-model catalog cutout from the exact-model reference, using the approved original owner-vehicle cutout as the camera and lighting reference: one clean white vehicle, complete body visible, front-left three-quarter view facing left, camera near headlight height, consistent scale and margins, soft neutral studio light, restrained contact shadow, solid chroma-key magenta background for deterministic alpha extraction; no road, showroom, people, plate text, labels, watermark, cropped wheels or fantasy bodywork.
